name: codex-accounts-mailbox
description: Optional provider-neutral mailbox query and manual credential renewal integration for Codex Accounts Manager.

scripts.test: node --test test/core/*.test.cjs test/mailbox/*.test.cjs test/operations/*.test.cjs test/integration/*.test.cjs test/ui/*.test.cjs
scripts.package:check: npm run check && npm run audit:portability && node scripts/check-package.cjs
scripts.package: npm test && npm run package:check && node scripts/prepare-dist.cjs && npx --no-install vsce package --no-dependencies --out dist/codex-accounts-mailbox.vsix
